contract.asIsolationPrecondition: Fresh empty lease, real non-reparse ancestors, AS06/AS07/AS08 absent; no old tree or player-save access.
contract.teardown: Frozen RealArea.Dispose whitelist only; final lease empty; preserve/report unknown residue or sentinel drift.
contract.emptyLeaseMeaning: The verified empty post-run lease is the required using/Dispose postcondition, not evidence that AS tests did not execute.

AS06.behavior: Exercises real System.IO-backed activation files, Move/Replace/Flush, reads actual file bytes, and reopens state.

AS07.behavior: Creates and tests both an existing-target symlink and a dangling-target symlink; Read and Enter reject each, external sentinel bytes remain unchanged, and finally removes only the exact link.

conclusion.independentSystemCallLog: Not required by the asIsolation contract; its absence is not a contract gap.
conclusion.realProcessRestart: NOT_PROVEN; AS06 injects a next-process token and explicitly does not simulate an actual process restart.
conclusion.scope: This accepts evidence only within the specified AS06/AS07 contract-test scope; it is not an external filesystem audit.

wholeRun.failure: More than one current SDK ADB server; Final monitor gate
wholeRun.effect: Clarifies only the AS06/AS07 evidence sufficiency interpretation; it does not change the failed runner verdict or trigger a rerun.

scopeNote: Read-only evidence clarification. No source edits, tests, Unity, cache scan, process probe, or Git operation was performed.
